Blissville Terraces: More than drawings on paper

  
  

There comes a moment on every building project when 2D drawings stop being just lines on paper and start becoming walls you can touch, rooms you can enter, and floors you can stand on.

  

That is where Blissville Terraces is today.

  

Our progress over the past quarter has brought the development step closer to the homes we once envisioned, and that will one day become your home.

  

While the development has experienced some updates to its construction timeline due to extended regulatory approval processes and cost pressures resulting from recurring inflationary trends, construction has continued steadily on site, with significant progress made across the development this quarter.

  

Here are some of the key milestones we reached this past quarter:

•

Completed the structural framework for Building 1

•

Block work is ongoing, with standardisation in block production ensuring consistency and quality across the development

•

Column works are in ongoing on Building 2

•

Phase 2 of staircase construction

  
  

Structural frame 100% complete for Building 1

  
  

Ongoing Column works for Building 2

  
  
  

Staircase construction Ongoing

  

Ongoing block work

  
  
  
  

Men at work - Concreting

  
  

Precision is key while executing stairs

  
  

These milestones may look like individual stages of construction, but together, they mark the steady transformation of Blissville Terraces from a plan on paper into a development you can begin to see and experience.

  

As the buildings take shape, so does the opportunity to make a home your own.

  

Every structural milestone brings Blissville Terraces closer to completion. But for some homeowners, the exciting part is not simply moving into a finished house. It is creating a home that reflects how they actually want to live.

  

That is the idea behind The Canvas.

  

Rather than adapting to someone else's choices, The Canvas gives homeowners the opportunity to create a home around their own taste, priorities and way of living.

Beyond the development

  
  
  

The progress doesn’t just stop at our gates, it cuts across the whole neighbourhood.

  

Last quarter, attention in Sangotedo turned to the Ito Omu Link Bridge, located less than 500 metres from Blissville Terraces. The Governor of Lagos State was in Sangotedo for the bridge's presentation ceremony, highlighting the importance of the project to the area's ongoing development. For the immediate neighbourhood, improved connectivity means easier movement in and around Sangotedo as the area continues to grow.

  
  
  

The neighbourhood is also becoming more convenient, with three new retail options now open nearby, adding to the growing range of amenities around the development.

  
  

Bokku Mart

A growing retail chain expanding its presence across Lagos.

  

TwinsFaja Superstores

Another retail addition to the neighbourhood around Blissville Terraces.

  
  
  
  

Market Square, Novare Lekki Mall

Located within one of Nigeria’s largest shopping malls, adding to the retail options available in Sangotedo.

  
  
  

For those who will call Blissville Terraces home, this means a neighbourhood that is more connected, more convenient, and set for long-term value.
